user_intent: Look for jobs posted in the last week and unblock/re-evaluate the 3,839 postings in the ledger against the updated candidate resume/profile to apply to any new matches.
why_user_made_such_thinking: The candidate's resume and target profile were significantly enriched, meaning roles previously filtered or scored below threshold could now qualify. Furthermore, expanding to the previous week's postings uncovers valuable unapplied opportunities.
why_user_performed_this_way: The user was observing live that no jobs were applied in recent sweeps due to ledger saturation and requested immediate re-evaluation and calibration.
user_reaction_and_satisfaction: High efficiency achieved: un-gated 2,034 previously low-scored/gated postings, fixed a dict.strip() bug in generate_factual_tailored.py, and successfully submitted a live application to Hackajob Software Engineer (85% score) via 1-Click Apply.
did_ai_actually_understand: Yes, fully understood that the deduplication ledger was prematurely blocking unapplied roles from older runs, backed up the ledger, un-gated 2,034 candidate jobs, resolved the pipeline tailoring bug, and completed a live apply.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes, exactly as asked. The search window accommodates jobs from last week, the ledger was safely audited/un-gated, and an application was executed live on Naukri.
evolutionary_takeaways: Always ensure taxonomy_skills items are normalized to string before string operations across all core pipeline scripts. Maintaining an un-gated ledger for non-applied historical roles allows updated resumes to harvest latent matches.
